verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, and the docs show multiple depository accounts (checking/savings) within one organization, with internal transfers between them. However, no first-party documentation describes opening checking sub-accounts or rules that automatically split incoming deposits. missing for 10: first-party docs on opening multiple checking sub-accounts, documented auto-allocation or percentage-split rules for incoming deposits, and evidence that auto-funding acts on deposits rather than scheduled transfers.
